KODAVA THAKK

Voice of the Hills · Brand Guidelines v2.0 · August 2026

01 · Brand Essence

The waveform is our script

Kodava Takk has no script of its own; it lives in the voice. The identity's central image is the Speaking Flame: the thook bolcha, the sacred hanging lamp of the ainmane, whose light radiates outward as audio waveform arcs, sound rings from a spoken word, above the hills of Kodagu, ringed by paddy grain. Ancient wisdom gives the brand its forms; modern technology gives it its pulse. Every application of this brand should feel rooted (drawn from real Kodava material culture), alive (motion, sound, and voice are first-class citizens), and owned (the community is the author; speakers, clans, and villages are credited, never "users").

02 · The Logo

The Speaking Flame seal

The seal exists in five official variants, all vectorized and supplied as SVG (infinitely scalable) with PNG exports. The full-color seal on ivory is the primary mark; every other variant serves a specific context. No other colorways are permitted.

PrimaryDefault. Ivory backgrounds, documents, app.
TransparentOverlays on photography via ivory panel.
Mono MaroonOne-color print, stamps, embossing, fax-grade uses.
ReversedOn maroon or dark surfaces; hero sections, merch.
Gold CeremonialFoil print, awards, invitations, festival materials.

Clear space & minimum size

Clear space around the seal equals the height of the lamp's flame on all sides; nothing enters this zone, including the wordmark's tagline. Minimum sizes: 32px digital and 12mm print for the full seal. Below that, use the flame badge (see Favicons). The seal is always upright, never rotated, stretched, outlined, shadowed, or recolored.

Wordmark lockups

Horizontal lockup: seal left, wordmark right — KODAVA THAKK set in Cormorant Garamond Bold, letter-spaced 14%, in Kupya Maroon, with ಕೊಡವ ತಕ್ಕ್ beneath in Noto Serif Kannada at 90% optical size in Mandethira Gold, and the tagline VOICE OF THE HILLS in Manrope, letter-spaced 40%, in Misty Grey. Stacked lockup: seal above, text centered beneath, for square and ceremonial formats. Both languages always appear together where space allows.

03 · Favicons & App Icons

The flame badge

The full seal blurs below 32px, so small sizes use the flame badge: the lamp, flame, and inner sound arcs in an ivory circle with a maroon ring. Sizes 128px and above use the full seal. The complete set ships in the asset pack.

04 · Color

Palette

Drawn from the kupya-chele ceremonial dress, ainmane brass and timber, and the Kodagu landscape. Ratio roughly 60% ivory, 25% maroon, 10% supporting tones, 5% gold. Gold is earned: emphasis and ritual moments only, never body text, never large fills.

Primary

Kupya Maroon#6E1E2A · RGB 110 30 42 · CMYK 0 73 62 57The ceremonial red-black of the kupya. Logo, headers, primary buttons.
Mandethira Gold#C9A227 · RGB 201 162 39 · CMYK 0 19 81 21Brass lamps and brocade. Accents, waveforms, highlights.
Ainmane Ivory#F7F1E5 · RGB 247 241 229 · CMYK 0 2 7 3Default background. Warm, archival, calm.

Secondary

Kodagu Forest#1F3D2BSuccess states, nature and land programs.
Kaveri Teal#2E5E6ELinks, audio player UI, tech surfaces.
Coffee Earth#4A2C1ABody text on ivory, footers.
Misty Grey#8C8578Captions, metadata, disabled states.

Accessibility

Approved text pairs (WCAG AA or better): Kupya Maroon on Ainmane Ivory; Coffee Earth on Ainmane Ivory; Ainmane Ivory on Kupya Maroon; Ainmane Ivory on Kodagu Forest; Ainmane Ivory on Kaveri Teal. Mandethira Gold fails contrast for text at body sizes: use it only for icons, rules, large display numerals, and decorative elements.

05 · Typography

Type system

A heritage serif for the voice of wisdom, a modern grotesque for the voice of technology, and first-class Kannada companions: Kodava Takk is written in Kannada script, and the two scripts always sit together with equal dignity. All four are free Google Fonts, so anyone in the community can use the brand at zero cost.

Display · Cormorant Garamond (SemiBold / Bold)
The recording is the text.
Kannada Display · Noto Serif Kannada
ಕೊಡವ ತಕ್ಕ್ · ನುಡಿಯೇ ಬರಹ
Body & UI · Manrope (Light / Regular / SemiBold)
Manrope carries interface text, long-form reading, captions and data: open, legible at small sizes, quietly technical without feeling cold.
Kannada Body & UI · Noto Sans Kannada
ಧ್ವನಿ ದಾಖಲೆ, ಪದಕೋಶ, ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಿಕೆ — ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಒಂದೇ ಘನತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ.

Scale & rules

Type scale (digital): H1 40/48, H2 30/38, H3 22/30 in Cormorant Garamond; body 16/26, caption 13/20 in Manrope. Kannada set at 90% of the paired Latin point size for optical balance. Elder quotations are set in Cormorant Garamond Italic with a gold left rule. Never distort, fauxbold, or set Kodava/Kannada text in decorative faces. Minimum body: 16px digital, 9.5pt print.

06 · Iconography

Icon language

One family, two registers, one grid: 24px base, 2px rounded strokes, maroon line with one optional gold accent, no fills, no shadows. Cultural motifs (48px and larger only) honor material heritage; functional icons (20 to 24px) run the product. Never combine two cultural motifs in one icon; never borrow motifs from other communities; when in doubt, photograph the real object in Kodagu and redraw it on the grid.

07 · Voice & Tone

How the brand speaks

Reverent, not nostalgic

Elders and traditions in the present tense. The language is living; the brand never eulogizes it.

Precise, not technical

"The app learns from your voice," not "we fine-tune transformer checkpoints." Depth lives in the docs.

Collective, not corporate

"Our voices, our data, our language." The community is the subject of every sentence.

08 · Usage

Do & Don't

Do

  • Use the supplied SVGs; they scale losslessly to any size
  • Keep clear space equal to the flame's height on all sides
  • Pair English lockups with ಕೊಡವ ತಕ್ಕ್ wherever space allows
  • Animate the waveform arcs when audio plays; the mark should feel alive
  • Use Mono Maroon for stamps, embroidery, and one-color print
  • Credit speakers and villages wherever their voices are used

Don't

  • Stretch, rotate, outline, shadow, or recolor the seal
  • Place the seal on busy photos without an ivory or maroon panel
  • Use the full seal below 32px; switch to the flame badge
  • Use gold for body text or strokes thinner than 2px
  • Mix the brand with AI clichés: glowing brains, blue circuits, robots
  • Use sacred or funerary imagery in marketing contexts
09 · Asset Pack

File inventory & naming

Everything ships in kodava-thakk-brand-assets.zip. Naming convention: kodava-thakk-logo-[variant].[ext]. SVG is the source of truth; export PNGs from it at any size you need.
